intent: Gen IV radial-glow revision of the existing apex Redjack corrupted-void candidate: add a reactor-centered radial corruption aura with a controlled red-to-violet falloff while preserving the detailed void-breach shader, silhouette, palette, composition, and background.

delta.targeted_correction: Add a radial glow layer to the existing Gen IV shader while keeping the detailed void-breach treatment, geometry, composition, background, and palette roles unchanged.
delta.detail: Change only the shader detail: add a reactor-centered radial corruption aura behind and through the existing Redjack silhouette. The glow should be strongest at the reactor, red/pink near the source, transition through hot magenta, and fall off into a violet pixel-dithered halo around the hull. Use a stepped radial falloff with a few broken scanline rings and interference ripples, but keep the existing fracture network, offset echoes, and void-breach detail visible. The radial layer must feel shader-driven, remain contained around the enemy, and never wash out the silhouette or deep navy starfield.

reference_images.description: Existing detailed Gen IV candidate to revise; preserve its composition, void-breach detail, and geometry while adding only the radial glow layer.

preserve the current Redjack red energy and pale red accent palette with violet as the corruption layer
